Native Salesforce observations from an isolated scratch org at matching source and transport API 62.0 and 67.0. Anonymous Apex wrapped each Test.startTest or Test.stopTest call in try/catch(Exception); both escaped as System.FinalException. Named Apex tests queued a future inside a test boundary; its callback recorded Limits queueable jobs, future calls, and DML statements as used/limit. The fixture retains only those observations and removes unrelated identifiers. These rows do not establish queueable enforcement or non-test future behavior.
